description: ODEPA, the agricultural studies and policy office of Chile's Ministry of Agriculture, publishes the country's reference series of food prices. The core series gives daily wholesale prices and traded volumes of fruit and vegetables in the main wholesale markets of nine regions, posted each morning by 08:00; further series give weekly and monthly consumer prices of food basket items, and historical series can be consulted for past years. Coverage is national through the main markets of each region. The series are free and available to download from the ODEPA prices section; no licence terms are stated on the page read. Caveats: volumes are those declared at the markets covered, not total national supply, and product lists and market coverage have changed over time. Simulation uses: modelling flows of fresh produce between producing regions and urban wholesale markets, detecting supply disruptions from road closures or disasters through price and volume jumps, and calibrating food system resilience models. Related records: Mexico's SNIIM wholesale market data (data-sniim-mexico-wholesale-market-prices-and-inflows) is a comparable national series, and the WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) give wider coverage.
